content.text: thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, Gen. 22:2. Isaac loved Esau, Gen. 25:28. seven years … seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had, Gen. 29:20. he loved also Rachel more than Leah, Gen. 29:30. Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, Gen. 37:3. shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, Ex. 20:6 (Deut. 5:10). thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, Lev. 19:18 (Matt. 5:43; 19:19; 22:39; Mark 12:31; Luke 10:27; Rom. 13:9; Gal. 5:14; James 2:8; Mosiah 23:15; D&C 59:6). stranger that dwelleth with you … love him as thyself, Lev. 19:34. thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, Deut. 6:5 (30:6; Matt. 22:37; D&C 59:5). because the Lord loved you … redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, Deut. 7:8. Love ye … the stranger, Deut. 10:19. proveth you, to know whether ye love the Lord, Deut. 13:3. love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, Deut. 30:16. Jonathan … thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women, 2 Sam. 1:26. king Solomon loved many strange women, 1 Kgs. 11:1. Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness, Ps. 45:7 (Heb. 1:9). Ye that love the Lord, hate evil, Ps. 97:10. I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice, Ps. 116:1. whom the Lord loveth he correcteth, Prov. 3:12 (Heb. 12:6). rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee, Prov. 9:8. love covereth all sins, Prov. 10:12. Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, Prov. 15:17. A friend loveth at all times, Prov. 17:17. Open rebuke is better than secret love, Prov. 27:5. time to love, and a time to hate, Eccl. 3:8. Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest, Eccl. 9:9. in his love and in his pity he redeemed them, Isa. 63:9. I have loved thee with an everlasting love, Jer. 31:3. thy time was the time of love, Ezek. 16:8. I drew them … with bands of love, Hosea 11:4. I will love them freely, Hosea 14:4. love the good, Amos 5:15. to do justly, and to love mercy, Micah 6:8. I have loved you, saith the Lord, Mal. 1:2.

Love your enemies, Matt. 5:44 (Luke 6:27, 35; 3 Ne. 12:44). if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye, Matt. 5:46. serve two masters … he will hate the one, and love the other, Matt. 6:24 (Luke 16:13). He that loveth father or mother more than me, Matt. 10:37. love of many shall wax cold, Matt. 24:12 (JS—M 1:30). which of them will love him most, Luke 7:42. ye tithe mint … and pass over … the love of God, Luke 11:42. God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, John 3:16. men loved darkness rather than light, John 3:19 (D&C 29:45). Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things, John 3:35. Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things, John 5:20. ye have not the love of God in you, John 5:42. If God were your Father, ye would love me, John 8:42. my Father love me, because I lay down my life, John 10:17. He that loveth his life shall lose it, John 12:25. having loved his own … he loved them unto the end, John 13:1. new commandment … That ye love one another, John 13:34 (15:12, 17; 2 Jn. 1:5; D&C 88:123; Moses 7:33). ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another, John 13:35. If ye love me, keep my commandments, John 14:15 (D&C 42:29). keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love, John 15:10. Greater love hath no man than this, John 15:13. If ye were of the world, the world would love his own, John 15:19. hast loved them, as thou hast loved me, John 17:23. love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, John 17:26. Peter … lovest thou me more than these, John 21:15. love of God is shed abroad in our hearts, Rom. 5:5. work together for good to them that love God, Rom. 8:28. Who shall separate us from the love of Christ, Rom. 8:35. be able to separate us from the love of God, Rom. 8:39. Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated, Rom. 9:13. kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love, Rom. 12:10. love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law, Rom. 13:8. Love worketh no ill … love is the fulfilling of the law, Rom. 13:10. Eye hath not seen … the things which God hath prepared for them that love him, 1 Cor. 2:9. if any man love God, the same is known of him, 1 Cor. 8:3. now abideth faith, hope, charity, 1 Cor. 13:13 (Moro. 7:47). love of Christ constraineth us, 2 Cor. 5:14. by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned, 2 Cor. 6:6. to prove the sincerity of your love, 2 Cor. 8:8. God loveth a cheerful giver, 2 Cor. 9:7. faith which worketh by love, Gal. 5:6. by love serve one another, Gal. 5:13. the law is fulfilled in … this … love thy neighbour, Gal. 5:14. fruit of the Spirit is love, Gal. 5:22. ye, being rooted and grounded in love, Eph. 3:17. to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, Eph. 3:19. walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, Eph. 5:2. Husbands, love your wives, Eph. 5:25 (Col. 3:19). ye be likeminded, having the same love, Philip. 2:2. be comforted, being knit together in love, Col. 2:2. Remembering without ceasing your … labour of love, 1 Thes. 1:3. abound in love one toward another, 1 Thes. 3:12. putting on the breastplate of faith and love, 1 Thes. 5:8. Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation, 2 Thes. 2:16. direct your hearts into the love of God, 2 Thes. 3:5. love of money is the root of all evil, 1 Tim. 6:10. unto all them also that love his appearing, 2 Tim. 4:8. teach the young women … to love their husbands, to love their children, Titus 2:4. labour of love … ye have ministered to the saints, Heb. 6:10. Let brotherly love continue, Heb. 13:1. crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him, James 1:12. love one another with a pure heart, 1 Pet. 1:22. Love the brotherhood, 1 Pet. 2:17. in him verily is the love of God perfected, 1 Jn. 2:5. He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, 1 Jn. 2:10. Love not the world, 1 Jn. 2:15. what manner of love the Father hath bestowed, 1 Jn. 3:1. we love the brethren, 1 Jn. 3:14. love one another, as he gave us commandment, 1 Jn. 3:23. love one another: for love is of God, 1 Jn. 4:7. He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love, 1 Jn. 4:8. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, 1 Jn. 4:16. no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear, 1 Jn. 4:18 (Moro. 8:16). We love him, because he first loved us, 1 Jn. 4:19. he who loveth God love his brother, 1 Jn. 4:21. we love the children of God, when we love God, 1 Jn. 5:2. this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments, 1 Jn. 5:3 (2 Jn. 1:6). As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten, Rev. 3:19. they loved not their lives unto the death, Rev. 12:11.

love of God, which sheddeth itself abroad, 1 Ne. 11:22. encircled about eternally in the arms of his love, 2 Ne. 1:15. He hath filled me with his love, 2 Ne. 4:21. all men should have charity, which charity is love, 2 Ne. 26:30. hope, and a love of God and of all men, 2 Ne. 31:20. feast upon his love, Jacob 3:2. be filled with love towards God and all men, Mosiah 2:4. teach them to love one another, Mosiah 4:15. if ye have felt to sing the song of redeeming love, Alma 5:26. thou lovest that lucre more than him, Alma 11:24. patient, full of love and all long-suffering, Alma 13:28. bridle all your passions, that ye may be filled with love, Alma 38:12. no contention in the land, because of the love of God, 4 Ne. 1:15. ye do love money … more than ye love the poor, Morm. 8:37. love which thou hast had for the children of men is charity, Ether 12:34. charity is the pure love of Christ, Moro. 7:47. pray … that ye may be filled with this love, Moro. 7:48. charity, which is everlasting love, Moro. 8:17. perfect love, which love endureth by diligence, Moro. 8:26. love God with all your might, mind and strength, Moro. 10:32.

faith, hope, charity and love … qualify him, D&C 4:5. no one can assist in this work except he shall be humble and full of love, D&C 12:8. they should love and serve him, D&C 20:19. sanctification … to all those who love and serve God, D&C 20:31. so loved the world that he gave his own life, D&C 34:3. love thy wife with all thy heart, D&C 42:22. Thou shalt live together in love, D&C 42:45. Only Begotten Son whom the Father loved, D&C 76:25. whosoever loves and makes a lie, D&C 76:103. virtue loveth virtue, D&C 88:40. let thy love be for them as for thyself, D&C 112:11. Reproving betimes with sharpness … showing forth afterwards an increase of love, D&C 121:43. wonderful love made manifest by the Father and the Son, D&C 138:3.
